title: One-Roll Malevolent Cult — Specific Traits of the Cult

entries.value: It favours monstrous body alterations or markings
It is a remnant of a now-dead culture — Roman, Pictish, pre-Roman
It possesses a variety of potent ancient relics
It is a sect of a better-known public faith
It cuts secret deals with members of the ruling class
It has a totemic beast or monstrous creature type
They live where normal people could not survive
They practise some form of forbidden consumption
They have agents in other religious groups
They were thought to have been wiped out in the past
A significant subculture of the land is friendly to it
It employs unusual enchantments or old Roman magic
It has obedient monstrous servants bound to it
An area is tacitly understood to belong to it — enter at your peril
It was once a public and powerful faith
It has open sympathisers among the great and powerful
It is thought by some to hold back some awful doom
Its surface members look entirely unremarkable
The visible part of the cult is only a fraction of it
They serve a purpose that once made sense but no longer does
